== Biography ==
John was born in 1861. 
<ref>Estimated from Census 
</ref>

On 12th May 1886 John Elder grocer of Rasharkin, father John Elder, farmer, married Annie Patterson, 20 years, spinster of Raaharkin, father David Patterson, farmer, at 2nd Portglenone Presbyterian Church. <ref>Ballymena SR District  https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/images/marriage_returns/marriages_1886/10833/5951328.pdf </ref> 

In 1901 the Elder family were living in Carnfinton, John 39, grocer, his wife Annie 34, and their children John 13, Kate 10, Lizzie 8, Sarah 6, and Mary 5. All born County Antrim. <ref> https://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Antrim/Killoquin_Lower/Carnfinton/946449/ </ref>

A reproduced Second Portglenone Presbyterian marriage list records John Elder, full-age bachelor of Rasharkin, marrying Annie Patterson, aged 20, on 12 May 1886. John's father is recorded as John Elder, farmer; Annie's father as David Patterson, farmer.<ref>Second Portglenone Presbyterian civil marriage 1886; [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1886/10833/5951328.pdf record].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns John Elder. The 1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory lists John Elder, junior, as a grocer and postmaster among the inhabitants of Rasharkin. In the neighbourhood section it separately lists James Elder and James Elder, junior at Ballydonnelly.<ref>1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory, Rasharkin; [https://lennonwylie.co.uk/PT191214.htm record].</ref> They add useful identity clues for separating the later Elder households, but the directory does not identify either man as Robert Elder's son or brother. The source is a directory, not a parentage record. The identification remains uncertain.
